summary: Completed frontend-only testing of Pathfinder static landing page. All 10 sections render (hero, problem, howitworks, aichat, itinerary, sustainability, advancedai, final-cta, footer + landing wrapper). All hero CTAs and Final CTA correctly smooth-scroll to expected sections (aichat top ~0, itinerary top ~0). Desktop nav buttons work for all 5 links (The Problem, How It Works, AI Companion, Itinerary, Impact). SVG Greece map renders with 6 clickable pins. Recharts elevation graph renders. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow, hamburger toggle present, all sections render. No console errors / page errors on load or interactions.

issues: Non-blocking Recharts warning: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' fired once at first paint before ResponsiveContainer measures. Chart renders correctly afterward. Consider setting min-height on the chart container to suppress the warning.

data_testid_spec_mismatches.actual: 4 cards (problem-stat-tourists, problem-stat-concentration, problem-stat-revenue, problem-stat-undiscovered). Visually a bento with 4 cards looks intentional; confirm with PM whether 5 was intended.
Code uses itinerary-elevation, itinerary-weather, day-plan-item-{0..4}. Elements render and are visible; only the testid names differ from the spec.

Code has pins: pindus, olympus, vikos, mani, samaria, naxos. Spec listed meteora/taygetos as examples; map renders 6 pins which all are clickable. Consider aligning pin set with marketing copy if needed.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Align data-testids in Itinerary.jsx with spec (elevation-graph, weather-timeline, day-plan-{i}) OR update spec docs to match existing testids (itinerary-elevation, itinerary-weather, day-plan-item-{i}).
OPTIONAL: Confirm whether Problem section should have 5 cards (spec) vs current 4.
OPTIONAL: Suppress Recharts width/height(-1) warning by giving the chart container an explicit min-height so first render has positive dimensions.
critical_code_review_comments: No backend wiring needed (static page) — App.js correctly mounts all sections in declared order.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes (hero buttons, nav toggle, map pins, final CTA) — testability is good.
No console errors and no page errors during navigation, scroll, button clicks, or pin clicks.
Mobile layout: no horizontal overflow at 390px; nav-mobile-toggle present and functional.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows pass; testid-name spec mismatches noted as non-blocking

context_for_next_testing_agent: Static landing page at https://pathfinder-trails.preview.emergentagent.com. All sections, hero CTA scroll, navbar smooth scroll, map pins, mobile responsiveness verified. Only spec-vs-code data-testid naming mismatches and a benign Recharts warning remain. No regressions observed.
